entities.summary: Hanna-l-Fakhoury was a Lebanese Melkite priest, member of the Missionaries of St. Paul Society, philosopher and linguist. He was born in Zahlé, Lebanon, where his family moved from the village of Majdaloun near Baalbek بعلبك. In 1927 he joined the "Séminaire Sainte-Anne de Jérusalem" where he completed his basic education in 1936. He was ordained to priesthood in 1943.
